name: Roasted coffee
definition: roasted coffee beans sold whole or ground (grind an attribute), including drip bags (a pack form).
notes: shop page sells roasted whole bean medium roast coffees, grind options

name: Green (unroasted) coffee
definition: raw, unroasted coffee beans sold to roast.
notes: shops sell green coffee for home roasters, 2 kg units

name: Instant coffee
definition: soluble dried coffee extract, including a dry mix whose largest ingredient by weight is coffee (attribute `mix`, K-49).
notes: Gold Blend: soluble coffee plus 3% roast and ground; freeze-dried

name: Coffee capsule or pod (machine system)
definition: single-serve capsule, E.S.E. pod or paper pad of coffee made for one machine system (system in the C13 ledger).
notes: Original and Vertuo capsules, each only for its own machine

name: Liquid coffee concentrate
definition: liquid coffee extract sold to dilute, coffee its main ingredient; a sweetened or milk ready-to-drink is OUT (J6-O1).
notes: bottle sold to dilute with water, 24 servings per bottle

name: Cocoa beans
definition: whole cacao beans, raw, fermented and dried, or roasted.
notes: fermented sun-dried Trinitario beans, single estate

name: Cocoa nibs
definition: cocoa beans cracked and shelled into pieces, raw or roasted.
notes: roasted unsweetened nibs; raw criollo trinitario blend nibs

name: Cocoa shells and husks
definition: the shell of the cocoa bean, sold for infusion.
notes: husk tea from cacao husks; sold as tea

name: Cocoa paste or mass
definition: ground cocoa nibs set in a block or drops (cocoa liquor, ceremonial cacao); couverture and baking chocolate are J5 (K-50).
notes: ceremonial cacao paste block and buttons

name: Cocoa butter
definition: the fat pressed from cocoa paste (K-50).
notes: cacao butter chunks; natural or deodorized wafers

name: Cocoa powder
definition: unsweetened powder of pressed cocoa solids, natural, Dutch-process or black (alkalisation and fat content attributes).
notes: natural and Dutched powders; alkalised 22-24% fat; black cocoa in FAQ

name: Drinking chocolate powder
definition: sweetened cocoa powder for a drink, cocoa its largest ingredient by weight; a sugar-led mix is OUT (K-49).
notes: hot chocolate mixes; Van Houten drink powder organic sugar plus cocoa powder
